import.title: Add asset
import.description:
The file you upload becomes version 1.
3D assets take GLB; backgrounds take EXR; drawings take PDF, SVG and images; CAD takes DWG, DXF, STEP and IGES.
import.pickFile: Choose a file or drop it here

versions.uploadHint: Changing the file creates a new version. Earlier versions are kept.

versions.removeHint: The file for this version is deleted and cannot be restored. Only versions that were never published can be deleted.

versions.uploadUnavailable: New versions cannot be uploaded in this environment. Upload in the development environment and deploy.

optimize.label: Optimize
optimize.hint: Shrinks and re-encodes textures and compresses geometry before storing. The uploaded original is kept separately.
optimize.stored: Stored optimized. Left is the stored size, right is the uploaded original.
optimize.hintMap: Shrinks textures and simplifies and compresses geometry before storing. Wide terrain is split into tiles and LODs — the method is chosen by measuring the file. The uploaded original is kept separately.

placement.paletteHint: When off, the asset is left out of the 3D editor palette. Use it for assets that are never placed in a scene, such as parts the app code loads directly.

mapRoleHint.ground: The floor that dropped models land on. Adding it also makes it a reference for the camera range.
mapRoleHint.context: Terrain outside the work area. It has many triangles, so it is left out of shadows and sea reflections and is not used as the floor when placing models.

placement.defaultPositionHint: Where the map goes when added from the palette. Use it to line up several maps that share a coordinate system.
placement.note: Changes here apply the next time the asset is placed. Anything already in a scene stays as it is.

remove.in-use: A scene or the app code is using it (used in {{count}} places). Remove it from the scene or switch to another asset first.
remove.usage-unknown: Not every scene could be read, so it is unknown whether this asset is in use. Read the usage again before deleting.

protect.removeBlocked: The asset is in use, so it was not deleted. Check where it is used.
protect.withdrawBlocked: The version is in use, so it was not withdrawn. Check where it is used.
protect.withdrawInUse: A version used by a scene or the app code cannot be withdrawn.
